title: [docs] Improve page - 'Troubleshooting performance issues' to include details of troubleshooting P99 latency issues.

events.body_markdown:
https://docs.yugabyte.com/latest/benchmark/performance-troubleshooting/

Improve page - 'Troubleshooting performance issues' to include details of troubleshooting P99 latency issues.

Document the gflags - enable_tracing, rpc_slow_query_threshold_ms, print_trace_every and collect_end_to_end_traces.

Document the best practices on using the above and the side effects like excessive memory allocations.
